title: Liam Coen: Everything said kick FG late in fourth, going for it a "hope play"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Liam Coen: Everything said kick FG late in fourth, going for it a "hope play"
sources.description: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen opted to kick a field goal from the 9-yard-line and cut the Giants' lead to 23-18 with just over three minutes to play in Sunday's game, but hopes of winning the game with a touchdown went up in smoke when the Giants picked up two first downs and ran out the clock.
